The [Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)](https://equalsmoney.com/financial-glossary/federal-open-market-committee) meets eight scheduled times a year to discuss and set monetary policy, and its decisions have a major impact on financial markets, mortgage rates, and economic growth. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is the branch of the [Federal Reserve](https://equalsmoney.com/financial-glossary/federal-reserve-system) responsible for setting monetary policy for the US. The Federal Open Market Committee is composed of twelve members, each with expertise in economics and [monetary policy](https://equalsmoney.com/financial-glossary/monetary-policy). *   The Federal Reserve’s latest projections (March 2026) point to [**around one rate cut in 2026**](https://www.barrons.com/livecoverage/fed-meeting-march-interest-rate-cut-decision-powell-trump/card/fed-still-points-to-just-one-rate-cut-this-year-wGNrKriyHwsTL7AcMqBy), not a full cutting cycle. *   Policymakers have emphasised that [**any cuts will depend on incoming data**](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/international-business/fomc-policy-meeting-march-2026-jerome-powell-led-us-federal-reserve-keeps-interest-rates-unchanged-amid-middle-east-conflict/articleshow/129662176.cms), especially inflation. *   **Inflation remains**[**above the Fed’s 2% target**](https://www.marketwatch.com/livecoverage/fed-meeting-today-iran-inflation-interest-rates/card/fed-raises-its-inflation-forecast-for-2026-pce-prices-seen-rising-2-7-this-year-xcByBXihEKqROdX0Lydv), and forecasts for 2026 have been revised higher. **See more here:**[**_When is the next Fed interest rate decision?_**](https://equalsmoney.com/economic-calendar/events/fed-interest-rate-decision). **The current**[**federal funds rate**](https://equalsmoney.com/financial-glossary/federal-funds-rate)**target range is 3.50% – 3.75%**. [See all events](https://equalsmoney.com/economic-calendar).
